description: The internship develops the undergraduate education programme in Electrical Engineering to include practical training in a professional engineering setup (a company, top educational institution or research institute). After the 4th and 6th semesters students undertake a two-month internship/industrial training programme of one credit; the viva voce examination is conducted in the following semester. Each student is assigned a faculty supervisor who manages and assesses the internship, including a reflective diary, an interim report, a final report with a learning agreement, and a final presentation and viva.
outcomes: Acquire knowledge and experience of software and hardware practices in the project area.
Carry out design calculations and implementations in the project area.
Associate with the implementation of the internship requiring individual and teamwork skills.
Communicate work effectively through writing and presentation.
Demonstrate knowledge of professional responsibilities and respect for ethics.
